fact_text: The SCSTrade charting toolbar has basic tools (crosshair, trend line, extended line, horizontal and vertical lines) and advanced tools (Fibonacci retracement, trend-based extension, Fibonacci circles, spiral and pitchfork fans).
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '6. How to Use Tools in SCSTrade.com | Make Your Charts More Professional Like Pro Trader' (YouTube, 2024-09-26)

fact_text: A chart is opened by typing a stock symbol or index name, such as KSE-100, into the symbol search box on the terminal.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '6. How to Use Tools in SCSTrade.com | Make Your Charts More Professional Like Pro Trader' (YouTube, 2024-09-26)

fact_text: A trend line is drawn by clicking a low and dragging to a second point; its settings window sets line weight, colour, dashed or dotted style, and where the label sits (top, middle or bottom).
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '6. How to Use Tools in SCSTrade.com | Make Your Charts More Professional Like Pro Trader' (YouTube, 2024-09-26)

fact_text: The Fibonacci retracement tool is drawn from the bottom of an upward move to its top, to show the levels a market correction may reach.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '6. How to Use Tools in SCSTrade.com | Make Your Charts More Professional Like Pro Trader' (YouTube, 2024-09-26)

fact_text: The trend-based extension tool is drawn from one swing point to a second swing point, and its settings let the user set the label and drag the tool to project further levels.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '6. How to Use Tools in SCSTrade.com | Make Your Charts More Professional Like Pro Trader' (YouTube, 2024-09-26)

fact_text: The long and short position tools shade a reward zone and a risk zone, and show the risk-to-reward ratio set by the chosen risk percentage and reward percentage.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '6. How to Use Tools in SCSTrade.com | Make Your Charts More Professional Like Pro Trader' (YouTube, 2024-09-26)

fact_text: With a 5% risk setting and a 15% reward setting, the position tool displays a 3:1 risk-to-reward ratio.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '6. How to Use Tools in SCSTrade.com | Make Your Charts More Professional Like Pro Trader' (YouTube, 2024-09-26)

fact_text: Brush and rectangle tools mark a support or resistance zone; the analyst treats a resistance zone as a level where price may be rejected, and colours its border and fill to separate them.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '6. How to Use Tools in SCSTrade.com | Make Your Charts More Professional Like Pro Trader' (YouTube, 2024-09-26)

fact_text: Chart settings control candle colours, the status price line, the countdown to bar close and the canvas background; the analyst usually keeps a black background.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '6. How to Use Tools in SCSTrade.com | Make Your Charts More Professional Like Pro Trader' (YouTube, 2024-09-26)
